description: Make a music bed or one short sound hit for an edit (the beat-and-hits editor workflow), with no voice and no words. kind "bed" gives an instrumental bed of about `seconds` (4 to 60, default 15) to run under the piece; kind "hit" gives one sub-second sound to place on every cut. Pass description in plain words: the feel, tempo, instruments, texture. It is charged through the same audio generation as generate_audio (a token quote applies per second) and the file is saved to your library. Returns audio_url, duration_seconds and generation_id.

description.description: The feel in plain words, under 400 characters. For example "warm lo-fi beat, 90 bpm, soft kick, no melody" or "short airy whoosh with a soft thump".

kind.description: "bed" for a music bed under the piece, "hit" for one short sound on a cut.

seconds.description: Bed length in seconds, 4 to 60. Default 15. Ignored for a hit.

name: generate_sound
title: Generate Sound
